rationale: I independently re-walked all 35 code cells of the original notebook against the untouched converted baseline and the exact source diff. The only changes are (1) input staging: the pooch DOI registry/fetch is replaced by loading the same two files from /inputs, which are the original inputs (matches for filenames, provider MD5, size and recorded SHA-256; staged_original_inputs confirms them, and setup re-verifies MD5/size at run time); sc.read_10x_h5 and every downstream consumer are unchanged; and (2) appended exports that are pure reads of existing state (to_csv on obs/var, DataFrame construction from obsm/uns, the source's own sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df getter, write_h5ad). No scientific parameter, formula, algorithm, label, seed, or threshold is altered: min_genes=100, min_cells=3, scrublet(batch_key='sample'), counts layer before normalize_total+log1p, HVG n_top_genes=2000 batch_key='sample', PCA, neighbors, UMAP, leiden flavor='igraph' n_iterations=2 plus the 0.02/0.5/2.0 loop with leiden_res_{res:4.2f} keys, the cell_type_lvl1 mapping from leiden_res_0.02, and rank_genes_groups(groupby='leiden_res_0.50', method='wilcoxon') with the cluster-'7' extraction. No branches are skipped, no errors suppressed, no source-level subsampling exists to preserve, and no exports mutate analysis state; export timing is coherent (pre-filter obs before filtering, var/HVG after HVG, PCA/UMAP/DEG immediately after computation, final obs+h5ad last, all into /work/outputs created by setup). Branch/endpoint coverage is complete: every narrative endpoint maps to exported underlying data — per-cell QC metrics (violin/scatter), gene flags + per-gene QC + HVG stats (HVG plot), PCA coordinates and variance ratios (PCA panels/variance-ratio plot), UMAP coordinates (all UMAP displays), final obs with sample/QC/doublet_score/predicted_doublet/all four leiden solutions/cell_type_lvl1 (cluster and QC UMAPs), the full per-cluster Wilcoxon DEG table including cluster-7 top-5 markers (rank dotplot, head(5) table, marker UMAP), and the complete final AnnData (counts layer, log1p X, X_pca, varm['PCs'], graph, uns incl. rank_genes_groups). The exclusions are reasonable: rendered figure files only; cell 55 exactly duplicates cell 54's display; the bare value_counts print and adata repr are subsumed by the obs tables/h5ad; the cluster-7 head(5) frame is fully contained in the exported DEG table; and the two marker-gene dotplot matrices are deterministic reductions (per-cluster mean expression, standard_scale='var') of data preserved in adata_final.h5ad (X + cluster labels; the marker list is a source input), while the annotation result those plots support (cell_type_lvl1) is itself exported — no separate intermediate artifact is required per policy. Setup was independently inspected: the prior failure (`set -o pipefail` illegal under dash) is fixed with POSIX `set -eu` and no pipelines; setup only builds the venv, installs the scverse stack (source declares no versions; resolved versions are recorded), performs a smoke import (not analysis), and stages/verifies the original inputs, so it does not execute any analysis. Remaining uncertainties are execution-time only and are recorded as checks: fresh-process venv/Agg execution, cp313 wheel availability for igraph/leidenalg/numba/umap-learn, adata.uns['pca']['variance_ratio'] access on the resolved scanpy, runtime/memory fit for the 600 s / 8 GiB reference budget, existence of cluster label '7' absent seeds, and output sizes under the 2 GiB download ceiling. No omitted scientific results, no prohibited changes, and no setup or export defects were found.
